observations: A light blue industrial-style sewing machine.
The brand 'AIG BROTHER' is printed in blue on the side of the machine body.
The machine is sitting on a white workbench with a ruler.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or factory setting.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
Photo 0 shows 'AIG BROTHER', not 'Ambro Brother'. The seller may be referring to the same brand.

claims.claim: Very strong, neat and durable. Sew very neat...
claims.evidence: This is a subjective assessment of the machine's current condition and performance.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motor may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and running.

risks.risk: The needle may be bent or the needle plate may be damaged.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the needle and the underside of the needle plate.

risks.risk: The machine may have internal rust or mechanical wear.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine being operated through a full stitch cycle.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and running.
Close-up photo of the needle and the underside of the needle plate.
Photo of the model number plate, usually found on the back or side of the machine.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
